changes.to: Maker press release (13 Oct 2026, CEATEC 2026 mass-production prototype): carrying capacity 8 kg per arm and 12 kg with both arms (payload field = 12 kg, bimanual), mechanics, electronics, embedded software and AI all developed in-house, shipments planned from 2027, mass-production partnership with Mitsubishi Motors signed 9 Jul 2026. No height, mass, DoF, battery or runtime in the maker release; the 1750 mm / 75 kg / 29 DoF / 48 V 22 Ah / about 2 h seen in trade press were not filled.
Highlanders' Japan-made full-size humanoid N, heading to mass production with Mitsubishi Motors for shipments from 2027.
